name: TIMOR-LESTE

flag.title: Timor-Leste Flag
flag.note: Red, yellow & black triangles, white star

lead: Timor-Leste became independent in 2002, making it one of the world's newest nations. It lies on a tropical island between Indonesia and Australia. Fewer tourists visit than almost anywhere in Asia, so its reefs stay wild.

facts.label: Capital

sections.wows: 7 things to make you go wow

geo: Timor-Leste covers the eastern part of Timor island, between the Timor Sea and the Banda Sea. Rugged mountains and coffee farms fill the land. The Oecusse area sits apart from the rest, wrapped in Indonesian land.
The Coral Triangle, a sea packed with reef life, laps its shores. Marine scientists call Ataúro island, 30 km north of the capital Dili, the island with the most fish on Earth.
animals: The Timor deer, called rusa, is a national symbol. Coconut crabs, the largest land crabs, climb palms on Ataúro.
Sperm whales and dolphins swim just offshore. The Timor imperial pigeon lives only on Timor and nearby Wetar island.
culture: Life revolves around the uma lulik, a sacred thatched house. Tais cloth carries clan stories, and no two designs are alike.
In the tebe-tebe dance, whole villages lock arms and sing for hours. Coffee roasters worldwide prize the country's chemical-free mountain coffee.
history: Portugal colonised Timor from the 1500s, trading sandalwood and coffee. Japan occupied it in World War II. In 1975, Indonesia invaded and ruled harshly for 24 years.
In a 1999 UN vote, 78% chose independence, despite violence. In 2002, Timor-Leste became Asia's newest nation. Nobel Peace Prize winners Bishop Belo and José Ramos-Horta led the fight.
wows: Timor-Leste is the only Asian country that uses the US dollar every day.
Ataúro island holds a record: over 250 reef fish species per survey site on average.
The country has over 30 local languages, roughly one per valley.
Timorese mountain coffee is organic and fair-trade (farmers get fair pay), sold in US shops.
Mount Tatamailau means 'Grandfather of All', and ancestors' spirits are said to climb it.
Sperm whales pass so close to Dili that spotters hear them blow.
Timor-Leste, the 21st century's first new country, became independent on 20 May 2002.

myths.myth: East Timor and Timor-Leste are different
myths.fact: They are one country. Timor comes from a Malay word for east. Leste is Portuguese for east.

myths.myth: Timor-Leste is mostly Muslim, like Indonesia
myths.fact: Nearly everyone is Catholic. Only the Philippines is also mostly Catholic in Asia.
